description: Compare up to 5 businesses side by side: the public profile fields plus services, BezalRank and whether the profile is claimed. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos and coordinates are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan.
